content.text: No cap exists anywhere in the document. Section 7 has only a mutual damages exclusion. I'll target the fallback with a single inserted cap sentence.

input.summary: Add a mutual 12-month fees liability cap in Section 7 with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 7 excludes indirect damages but sets no aggregate cap, so both Parties' direct liability (including ours) is unlimited. We have added our fallback position: a mutual cap of 12 months' fees, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct sitting outside the cap.

ops.text: Except with respect to a Party's indemnification obligations, breach of confidentiality obligations, gross negligence or willful misconduct, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
